profileName: Enterprise Intellectual Property and Usage Rights

cases.input: One brand references one sign registered separately in territories A and B with different expiry dates.
cases.expect: The brand, sign and two registrations remain separately identifiable and independently queryable.

cases.input: A non-exclusive license covering both territories expires in 2027 while registrations expire in 2029 and 2032.
cases.expect: The usage grant ends in 2027 without changing either registration lifecycle.

cases.input: The grant terminates while final reporting, audit and confidentiality duties survive.
cases.expect: The grant is terminated and the surviving WM-XCT-029 obligations remain active with their own deadlines.

cases.input: A territorial application is refused after claiming priority.
cases.expect: The application identity and priority evidence remain resolvable while no granted right is inferred.

cases.input: A creator attribution is used as conclusive proof that the creator owns the right.
cases.expect: The ownership conclusion is blocked until a dated sourced ownership claim or assignment basis is provided.

cases.input: Use of one company logo is treated as proof of exclusive trademark rights worldwide.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected because brand use does not establish territorial registration, ownership or exclusivity.

cases.input: A sublicense grants a territory and field of use outside the parent license.
cases.expect: The sublicense is invalid under the profile because its scope exceeds the parent grant.

cases.input: A portfolio assigns a durable master key to the IPAsset view and licenses that key directly.
cases.expect: Reject the master identity and require references to the protected subject, rights and contract grant.

cases.input: A dated claimant assertion automatically creates a legal right.
cases.expect: Reject promotion; the claim remains sourced evidence and does not mint a right.

cases.input: A register listing is treated as conclusive current beneficial ownership.
cases.expect: Keep registrant listing and ownership claim distinct and require dated provenance.

cases.input: Assignment of one territorial right creates a registration in another territory.
cases.expect: Reject the inferred registration and preserve independent territorial records.

cases.input: Confidentiality and audit obligations survive an expired licence.
cases.expect: Keep obligations active on the spent contract while the UsageGrant remains expired.

cases.input: A pending application is used as permission to exploit the sign.
cases.expect: Reject the grant inference; application is neither registration nor UsageGrant.

cases.input: A referenced territorial right expires while the contractual grant term continues.
cases.expect: Mark the affected grant scope indeterminate or reduced pending the instrument effect rule; never report it unaffected or extend the right.

cases.input: A registration record carries register, number and territory plus certificate evidence.
cases.expect: WM-KNW-003 owns the identity tuple and WM-REC-001 owns documentary evidence only.

cases.input: The profile creates a local sign key because no upstream subject authority is available.
cases.expect: Reject the hidden identity and keep the profile held until the subject resolves upstream.

cases.input: A parent licence authorizes a sublicense recorded inside the same contract without a separate instrument.
cases.expect: Create an addressable contract-local UsageGrant child pinned to parent authority, without a standalone model root.

cases.input: A right is invalidated with possible retroactive effect while grants reference it.
cases.expect: Open a held effect determination; do not mutate history or assert the grants unaffected.
